subtitle: Authorized accounts are checked when you open the page (results under 10 minutes old are reused). WorkBuddy's endpoint is risk-gated, so it's only queried when you click.
notConfigured: The creditSummary endpoint is not configured — add it in the WorkBuddy protocol panel.
noAccounts: No queryable WorkBuddy account yet — add one on the WorkBuddy page first.
parseFailed: Failed to parse the balance response
cursorAutoPoolHint: Includes Cursor Grok and Composer; beyond limits consumes Other Models quota or on-demand spend
grokExhausted: Included usage exhausted for this cycle
codexNoLimits: No limit windows returned for this plan

authHint.codex: Click Authorize and sign in to ChatGPT in your browser; you'll be brought back here to check the Codex quota.
authHint.cursor: Click Authorize and sign in to Cursor in your browser; you'll be brought back here to check usage.
authHint.grok-bot: Grok Bot uses Cursor accounts: click Authorize and sign in to the matching account in your browser.
authHint.workbuddy: Scan to sign in to a CodeBuddy account; it joins the account pool and its credits become queryable.
authHint.deepseek: DeepSeek has no authorization link — enter a platform API key to check the balance (stored on this machine only).

authPending: {{name}} authorization page opened in your browser — waiting for sign-in…
authPendingShort: Authorization page opened in your browser — waiting for sign-in…
removeAccountMessage: Delete the authorization tokens stored on this machine for "{{name}}"? The card is removed too; you'll need to authorize again to query it.
boardEmpty: No cards on the board yet — click + under "Add account" on the right to authorize one.
dsReplaceHint: Enter a new API key. Once verified it replaces this card (the old key is deleted).
wbIdle: Not checked yet (WorkBuddy is never queried automatically)
refreshAllHint: Query the Cursor / Grok Bot / Codex / DeepSeek accounts on the board in parallel; WorkBuddy refreshes separately.
refreshWbHint: WorkBuddy's quota endpoint is risk-gated: accounts are queried one by one (2 s apart), only when you click.
railNoAccounts: No authorized accounts yet — start from "Add account" below.
railShowAccount: Hidden — click to show and locate
